name: Treefolk
description: A creature type for sentient trees and guardians of the forests they inhabit.

timeline.summary: The Bosk is found leveled, uprooted, hacked and burned by unknown hands.
timeline.quote: The trees were torn out of the ground, hacked, and burned, all by unknown hands that acted with sustained will.

citation.text: "Murmuring Bosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Ancient tree beings fond of kithkin.
